twins: An extra stone follows its twin in the stone lists of a hint distribution (disabled, groups, remove_stones, priority_stones). OoTR's coop distribution disables all eleven of its grotto stones; the four extras are grotto stones, and their twins (DMT Storms Grotto: DMT's grotto stone, which the remake moved into the cow grotto; ZR Open Grotto and Kak Open Grotto: their area's grotto stone; KF Storms Grotto: the forest's grotto stone, the SFM grotto's label is GOSSIP_KOKIRI_FOREST_02) are all on that list, so coop disables the extras too. league, scrubs and sgl single out only HC Storms Grotto and HF Cow Grotto (each needs a second item past the entrance: a bombable wall, a spider web); no extra has a second obstacle and no twin is on those lists, so the extras stay ordinary stones there, as OoTR's generic grotto stones do.
disappear: GossipStoneDisappear.<label> (the stones' Presence, negated): Bool, ResetTypeValue 8 (reset only by a new game), SaveFileIndex 0 (saved). Set by the stone itself: AI/GossipStone.root.ainb state 5 runs _LocalModule_f9e82ae9180e (Launch_Ignition, Launch_Count, Launch, Launch_Crush; node 33 OneShotSetNonStructGameDataBool 'GossipStoneDisappear.' + its own instance name = true, node 9 OneShotDeathRequestDeath). State 5 comes from _LocalModule_c0e755492001 nodes 1/4/5/12: a hit that is not the player's own attack on the stone's Tgt sensor (QuerySensorHitIsHitTg IsCheckPlayerAttackOnly) with ExternalDamageTypes 7: most likely an explosion, as OoT's stones launch when bombed (the type enum is not named in the files). The player's own hits on the stone pick the Shake, ShakeVertical, Crush or Spin states (the sword's time-of-day event; Din's Fire and magic arrows spin it), none of which sets the flag. Not permanent: Sequence/LoadBancImpl.module node 54 SeqOneShotResetGameDataGossipStoneDisappear runs on every level load where Sequence_IsAnotherLoadArea is true (node 50/51), so a blown-away stone and its hint come back when the player enters from another area, as in OoT. No reset-type change is needed. Remake quirk: the adult Zora's Domain stone's Presence (IsAppear_GossipStone_ZoraDomain_Adult = SageOfWater_IsAfter_Step08_Exp and not GossipStoneDisappear.GOSSIP_KOKIRI_FOREST_01) reads the Kokiri Forest stone's flag, harmless because entering Zora's Domain is an area load that clears it.
